name: Judging On Appearances
overview: Scripture instructs believers to judge with righteousness rather than partiality, avoiding respect of persons based on outward status or appearance, as emphasized in Leviticus 19:15 and Proverbs 31:9. The Lord searches the heart and evaluates according to one's deeds, reminding us that true judgment must consider the unseen motives rather than external beauty or form, as Isaiah 53:2 and Jeremiah 17:10 reveal. Jesus further warns against hypocritical judgment in Matthew 7:1, calling believers to exercise mercy and compassion in their discernment, aligning with Zechariah 7:9's call to execute judgment grounded in truth and kindness.
